name: allowedDomains
label: Allowed sites
help: Sites allowed to show the embed; empty allows any site

name: password
label: Password
help: Explorer embeds only; null removes the password

name: config
label: Configuration
help: The look and behaviour of the embed, as the builder in Nubbo saves it. Optional: anything left out keeps the default of the kind, and a partial object is merged over it.

name: clear
label: Fields to clear
help: The fields to empty. A field left blank above keeps its current value.
